name: Shuushoku Mensetsukan ~Ryoujoku ADV Game
original_name: 就職面接官～陵辱ADVゲーム
source:
"It's simple. Whatever happens, if you don't refuse, you'll get the job."

Nakamura was the head of human resources at a small sales company. Life wasn't going so well for him lately. He was increasingly distrustful of his future at the company, disliked by his coworkers who saddled him with extra tasks, and home was no better. His fiancee was giving him the cold shoulder.
So when he was put in charge of interviews for the company's latest job applicants, all pretty young women who would no doubt go on to better lives and careers, he saw opportunity to carve out a little piece of happiness.

One by one, Nakamura turned the interviews into his own sexual screening process.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“很简单。无论发生什么，只要你不拒绝，你就会得到这份工作。”

中村是一家小型销售公司的人力资源主管。最近他的生活不太顺利。他对自己在公司的未来越来越不信任，同事们也不喜欢他，因为他们给他安排了额外的任务，家里也好不到哪儿去。他的未婚妻对他冷眼相待。
因此，当他负责公司最新求职者的面试时，这些求职者都是漂亮的年轻女性，毫无疑问她们会继续过上更好的生活和事业，他看到了创造一点幸福的机会。

中村将这些采访一一变成了他自己的性筛选过程。
